title: Soft-tether deployment worksheet
content:
Purpose:
Quick, messy worksheet for a 'soft tether' canary approach — aim is to slowly unpin active sessions from old model->new model while keeping traffic isolated and a fast escape hatch. This is personal scratchpad; not final runbook.

High-level idea (one line):
- Instead of an all-or-nothing model flip, keep a small tether of affinity to the prior model and admit new sessions to the new model on a controlled cadence; unpin after a warmup and quality confirmation.

Why this?
- Reduces sudden quality regressions for long-lived sessions (chat/assist flows)
- Lets us measure steady-state behaviour of new model on fresh sessions while minimizing blast radius
- Gives deterministic points to abort and re-pin if drift/hallucinations surface

Phases (A -> D):
A) Baseline collection (0% new): 2h
  - Goal: collect per-route baseline metrics for latency, server-error, client-error, token-cost, top-5 failure types (null responses, truncated, weird JSON)
  - Query snippets: PromQL: rate(app_infer_errors_total[5m]) / rate(app_infer_requests_total[5m])
  - Save baseline percentiles: p50/p90/p95 latency, p99 tail, model-prompt-retry-rate

B) Soft tether pilot (5% new sessions): 4h
  - Routing: new sessions assigned to model-v2 with 5% probability; existing sessions keep old model unless explicitly rehydrated after unpin window
  - Warmup: new sessions run a 3-turn synthetic priming prompt (light prompts) to prime caches and KV usage; track KV-cache-hit ratio
  - Monitors: latency, 5xx, hallucination rate (approx via annotation signal + high-entropy answer triggers), retention (session re-open rate)
  - Acceptance window: if 5xx > baseline + 0.5% OR hallucination rate > baseline * 1.5 -> abort and re-pin; note manual review required for subtle quality drifts
  - TODO: instrument a lightweight A/B diff-checker that samples N=100 threads/hour and runs comparison eval script (linked in INF-3421)

C) Expansion (20% new sessions): 6h
  - Only after green on B for 4h and no manual red flags
  - Increase bootstrapped sessions to 20% spaced over 30m increments (5% -> 10% -> 15% -> 20%) to observe slope effects on p95 latency and NVMe/CPU utilization
  - Add cost watch: tokens-per-response distribution and per-token time
  - Note: if latency p95 increases > 25% from baseline, we reduce to previous stable fraction and hold for 1h

D) Unpin wave (gradual unpinning of long-lived sessions): 12h+
  - Once new session cohort shows stable metrics for 12h, start unpin wave for sessions older than X minutes (configurable: start with >120m sessions) at 5% of eligible sessions per hour
  - Mechanism: Rollout-controller issues "unpin-intent" signal; SDK checks and migrates session state KV when safe (token state shape check)
  - Safety: if during unpin we detect structural KV deltas (e.g., v2 expects different token keys), abort and re-pin those sessions back to v1

Immediate rollback/abort criteria (quick checklist):
- 5xx rate absolute > 1% for any customer-critical route (chatbot, submissions)
- p95 latency > baseline by 25% sustained 15m
- Automated eval sample shows >10% regression in correctness score vs baseline (script: /ops/eval/quick-audit.sh)
- New class of errors (schema mismatch) observed -> immediate pinback

Operational commands (scratchy):
- Check per-route traffic split: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://internal-console/redwood/routes/<route>/split
- Force pin for a tenant: curl -X POST https://internal-api/tenants/<id>/pin -d '{"model":"v1"}'
- Shadow check (dry run): route-proxy --mode shadow --model v2 --sample 1000 --out /tmp/shadow.log

Unresolved questions / items to follow up:
- How to best surface hallucination proxy metrics without manual labels? (ask research: Marta)
- Does SDK session migration need schema v2 compatibility layer? PR #218 touches this but unclear on backward compat.
- Should we add a "priming budget" per tenant to avoid cold-start token spikes? (billing implications)
- Edge-case: mobile apps with intermittent connectivity — prefer keep pinned until explicit app restart? Discuss with mobile SDK owner.

Quick checklists for launch
- [ ] Create canary route and route-split config in Console (owner: Ethan)
- [ ] Wire up lightweight diff-eval job that compares 100 hourly sessions vs baseline (owner: Leila)
- [ ] Add temp telemetry view: "soft-tether/day-1" dashboard with p95, 5xx, hallucination-flag-rate, tokens-per-session (owner: Ops)
- [ ] Notify on-call channel + add a pinned message with abort steps + top contact list

Notes to self (voice memos turned into text):
- Keep the initial warmup prompts minimal — too much priming hides hallucination regressions.
- For session-affinity, prefer sticky cookie TTL shorter than 6h for first experiment so we can recover quicker.
- If we see steady divergence in user satisfaction proxies but no infra failures, prepare small targeted A/B with human raters for 200 samples (contact: UX research).

Handy refs (links I keep opening):
- INF-3421 (Linear): planning thread for soft-tether logic
- PR 218 (rollout-controller) — stateful unpin infra
- /ops/eval/quick-audit.sh — local script used during canary

End of worksheet. This is a living scratchpad: will refine after the first dry-run on staging.

-- leila
